systems.name: AQ anthraquinone donor–acceptor sensitizer
systems.constitution: 9,10-anthraquinone substituted at positions 2 and 6 by para-linked phenyl groups; each phenyl is para-substituted by N,N-bis(4-methoxyphenyl)amino (4,4'-dimethoxytriphenylamine) donor units. No counterions or solvent molecules.

systems.name: EQ cyano-functionalized analogue
systems.constitution: The AQ constitution with both anthraquinone carbonyls converted to exocyclic dicyanomethylene groups by malononitrile condensation; the two para-linked N,N-bis(4-methoxyphenyl)amino donor units and their positions are unchanged. No counterions or solvent molecules.
systems.connectivity_record: The constitution is defined by the stated transformation and formula; preserve neutral valence and stereochemical freedom at the exocyclic C=C groups. Generate and retain an explicit machine-readable structure before calculation.
